verification.notes: The source transcript and current podcast mirrors establish that Candace Owens made this attributed statement. Current third-party production metadata also connects Madison Bransford to 2025 Daily Wire video work as a host and writer. However, searches of current Daily Wire and general web sources found no Daily Wire announcement, program page, or independently preserved account post confirming a show titled 'In the Know,' a launch on Owens's former social accounts, Bransford's claimed intern status, or an intent to mock Owens. The attributed speech and a Daily Wire affiliation are supported, while the proposed show's operational details and motive remain uncorroborated.
